 How to watch Pacers vs 76ers
 Date: Sunday, November 15, 2026
 Time: 1:00 PM ET
 Channel: NBC Sports Philadelphia
 Stream: Fubo ( try for free ) 
 Philadelphia enters the contest with a 10-3 record after defeating the Toronto Raptors 123-112 on Thursday. Tyrese Maxey led the way with 27 points and eight assists, while Joel Embiid contributed 20 points. The 76ers will be without Embiid on Sunday, putting additional pressure on Maxey, LeBron James and Jaylen Brown to carry the offense as Philadelphia looks to remain near the top of the Eastern Conference standings.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Indiana comes into the matchup riding a two-game winning streak after edging the New York Knicks 106-104 on Friday. Pascal Siakam, Andrew Nembhard and Ivica Zubac will be important for a Pacers team looking to overcome the absence of Tyrese Haliburton. The 76ers won the first meeting between these teams 114-109 in October, setting up an intriguing rematch as Indiana looks to even the season series.
